title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 10

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. What transport arrangement has the group chosen for the visit?
tasks.audioText: Students on the business communication course will visit the airport information desk on Monday. The group will leave college at eight thirty by minibus and return before lunch. During the visit, staff will demonstrate how to answer passenger questions and explain delays politely. Students must wear their college identification badges and take a notebook.

tasks.prompt: A passenger asked an information assistant why a flight departure had changed. The assistant checked the airport display, explained that the new time was shown on the screen and directed the passenger to the airline desk for further details. She spoke calmly and repeated the information when the passenger asked her to clarify it. Reading 1. What information did the assistant check?
How did she respond to the passenger's request?
options: She repeated and clarified the information calmly

tasks.prompt: The assistant asked the passenger ___ wait near the information desk.
Choose TWO qualities important in customer service.
A person who travels by plane, bus or train is a ___.
A passenger asks you to repeat an announcement. What should you say?
options: Of course. I will explain it again more slowly.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of customer service in a sensible order.
options: Ask whether further help is needed
correctOrder: Ask whether further help is needed

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words describing how to help a visitor who needs information at an airport or college reception.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response identifies the visitor's information need and gives relevant help or directions (0–2); it includes polite clarification or checking that the visitor understands (0–2); the interaction is logically organised with understandable grammar (0–2); reception/directions vocabulary and polite expressions, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
